parsed.rationale: Both `CacheLoader` (package `Caching`) and `MetadataLoader` (package `Metadata`) share three identical members — `cacheKey:String`, `invalidate:() async`, and `lastLoadedAt:Date?` — and differ only in the return type of `load()`: `Data` vs `PlaycutMetadata`. This is the canonical PAT pattern: a single varying slot (`load:() async throws -> <Payload>`) across otherwise identical protocol shapes. Introducing `CacheLoadable` with `associatedtype Payload` and a default-constrained `load() async throws -> Payload` collapses both protocols into one, letting `CacheLoader` bind `Payload == Data` and `MetadataLoader` bind `Payload == PlaycutMetadata`.
